Name: A Dominican Colmado In Pierres General Store
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Colmado by CosmicSweetpea[/b][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This release already includes the contents of the former standalone [/color][color=#d4d4d8]Dominican Cooking[/color][color=#d4d4d8] mod. Do not install both versions together.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Bring a little Dominican warmth to Pelican Town with a colmado, a full interior expansion featuring Ramón and Ramona, traditional groceries, recipes, hot food, cafecito, frozen treats, furniture, decor, wallpapers, and a working stovetop coffee maker. Stop in to shop, eat, chat, and make the lower half of Pierre’s feel like the neighborhood gathering place it was always meant to be.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Six Clickable Shop Areas[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Grocery Shelf[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Main Cash Register - sells cooking recipes, saint candles, prayer cards, rosary beads, produce crates, Dominican decor, tropical floor plants, wallpapers, and a walkable textile rug.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Hot Plate -  serves a collection of Dominican meals, snacks, and desserts, including Mangú, Tres Golpes, Sancocho, Pastelón, Yaroa, Mofongo, Chicharrón, Quipes, Tostones, Tres Leches, Flan, and Habichuelas con Dulce.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Drink Cooler -  a selection of bottled and chilled beverages inspired by Dominican grocery store favorites.[/color][/*]
[*]Mamitas Freezer - carries eleven frozen treats[/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Cafecito Station -  sells, Coffee beans, Café Bustelo, Specialty bean varieties, Four finished mugs of coffee, Ramón’s Cafetera which is a moka.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b]Dominican Cooking[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]The colmado includes 20 learnable cooking recipes[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b]Cafecito Station[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]The coffee machine uses the coffee beans and Cafe Bustelo that are sold in the colmado. It also can use 5 vanilla coffee beans.[/*]
[/list]


[b]Credits and Permissions[/b]

[b]🖼️ — ARTWORK & USAGE — 🎨[/b]

All artwork included in this mod was created by me. Please do not reuse, edit, reupload, redistribute, sell, or include my artwork or files in another mod without my explicit permission.

[b]👽 — THE AI TAG — 👽[/b]

[b]Download the mod or do not. You may decide for yourself how seriously any of this should be taken.[/b]

[i]I am using this tag on all of my mods, regardless of how the individual assets were made. I made this decision after people began applying the AI label to my work based on assumption, regardless of how the individual assets were actually created. The tag is not a confession that every asset was generated by AI. It is a tongue-in-cheek response to every mod page now needing to double as a courtroom exhibit proving that its creator possesses motor skills, because I have apparently reached the stage of my twenty-year creative career where strangers require a forensic investigation before believing a human like myself can actually create. I have decided to save everyone the trouble and tag the entire catalogue. Thank you to the concerned citizens who helped me discover this.[/i]
